name: wellplaced
summary: Intended for the AEC industry, wellplaced is your contech solution to save planning time and cost of complex building projects. Experience your 3D data alone or globally synchronised as multiplayer session with full interactivity of all objects and voice chat. Visualize simple geometry or high class designs depending on your stage of planning. Building owners, planners and stakeholders can fully immerse in new designs and check equipment and workflows for issues and collisions. Experience your design in AR
